description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] How much a spender may take from an owner for a token, at one block, in exact base units and human units, flagging 'unlimited' approvals.

block.description: "latest" (default), "safe", "finalized", or a decimal block number. Every value in the answer is read at this one block

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

owner.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

spender.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)

token.description: 0x + 40 hex digits (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case)
